data: First asteroid sample return to Earth from Ryugu (Dec 2020); continuing extended mission to Torifune and 1998 KY26
Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.

Hayabusa2 is a deep-space orbiter built by NEC in Japan. Successfully returned ~5.4 grams of samples from asteroid 162173 Ryugu on December 6, 2020. After sample delivery, the spacecraft continued on an extended SHARP (Small Hazardous Asteroid Reconnaissance Probe) mission to other asteroids. It flew past asteroid Torifune on July 5, 2026, and is planned to rendezvous with asteroid 1998 KY26 in 2031.
Second asteroid sample return (Ryugu, 2020); first artificial impact crater on an asteroid; first subsurface asteroid material returned to Earth
